title: Beyond Before-and-After Images: Evaluating Temporal Grounding in a Lightweight VLM for Disaster Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.32022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bi-temporal satellite imagery is central to disaster assessment: deciding what was damaged requires comparing a pre-event scene with its post-event counterpart. A vision-language model (VLM) can nonetheless appear to answer change questions while relying mainly on the post-event image or on the prompt's temporal framing. We present a controlled diagnostic of temporal grounding and apply it to one lightweight VLM, InternVL3-2B, on DisasterM3: 1,659 optical and SAR image pairs from 41 events and nine disaster types, in event-disjoint partitions, with 9,031 reasoning questions. We compare post-only input, the true pre/post pair, the post image repeated twice, reversed image order, and an unrelated pre-event image. The true pair scores $+0.5$ accuracy points above the repeated-post control (95\% paired bootstrap CI $[-0.2, +1.2]$), and reversing the order changes accuracy by $-0.2$ points ($[-0.8, +0.5]$). translated_title: 超越前后对比图像：评估轻量级视觉语言模型在灾害评估中的时间定位能力
translated_abstract: 双时相卫星影像是灾害评估的核心：判断哪些区域受损需要将灾前场景与其灾后对应影像进行对比。然而，视觉语言模型（VLM）可能表面上回答了变化相关问题，实际上却主要依赖灾后影像或提示词中的时间表述。我们提出了一种受控的时间定位诊断方法，并将其应用于一个轻量级VLM——InternVL3-2B，在DisasterM3数据集上进行评估：该数据集包含来自41个事件、九种灾害类型的1,659对光学和SAR影像对，采用事件不相交的数据划分，共包含9,031个推理问题。我们对比了以下输入条件：仅灾后影像、真实的灾前/灾后影像对、灾后影像重复两次、影像顺序反转，以及无关的灾前影像。结果显示，真实影像对的准确率仅比重复灾后影像对照高0.5个百分点（95%配对自助法置信区间为[-0.2, +1.2]），反转影像顺序仅使准确率变化-0.2个百分点（[-0.8, +0.5]）。因此，在该诊断协议下……
tldr: 该研究提出受控诊断实验，发现轻量级VLM（InternVL3-2B）在灾害评估中并未真正利用灾前影像进行时间定位，其看似的变化推理实际主要依赖灾后影像和提示词表述。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a controlled diagnostic revealing that a lightweight VLM (InternVL3-2B) does not genuinely ground its change reasoning in pre-event imagery for disaster assessment, performing nearly identically under manipulated temporal input conditions.
